deficiencies.description: The addition of 'that is' equates acetylation or deacetylation with the state of transcription within the cell, creating an unsourced definitional link between two items that were merely listed in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: to the acetylation or deacetylation, the state of the transcription within the cell itself.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and to acetylation or deacetylation, that is, the state of transcription within the cell itself.

deficiencies.description: In the source text, 'they' refers to the human viruses predisposing to chronic inflammatory events. The rewrite widens the cause from these viruses to 'infection' in general.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: There are about seven different human viruses that will precipitate cancer, and they can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events that can also help to give rise to cancer.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: There are about seven different human viruses that precipitate cancer, and infection can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events, which can also help to give rise to cancer.

considerations.sourcePassage: So there's a lot of changes that occur, and as I said, we don't know pretty much because of this when they occur.
considerations.reason: The rewrite uses 'therefore' ('Many changes therefore occur') to reflect 'So' as a summary conclusion drawn from the preceding enumeration of genetic, epigenetic, and infectious changes.

considerations.sourcePassage: So I've just made this kind of a much simpler diagram, if you like.
considerations.reason: Converting the lecturer's first-person phrasing into the passive voice ('A much simpler diagram can be made') is an allowed stylistic change.
